notes: FY2024 and FY2025 from the Annual Report 2025 table 'Key figures by brand group and business field'; FY2023 from the Annual Report 2024 table (VW footnote: 'Prior-year figures adjusted' for the 2023 operating result). Restatement in AR2025: MAN Energy Solutions (renamed Everllence in 2025, majority stake being sold to Bain Capital), shown as a separate business field in AR2024 (revenue 4,044 / 4,333, operating result 369 / 337 in 2023 / 2024), is no longer shown separately; the AR2025 2024 'Other' line (revenue -18,643, OR -810) equals the AR2024 'Other' plus MAN Energy Solutions exactly, so for FY2023 MAN Energy Solutions is likewise included in 'Other' here (derived: revenue -24,350 + 4,044 = -20,306; OR -2,456 + 369 = -2,087) - this FY2023 'Other' figure is a derivation, not a published number. 'TRATON Commercial Vehicles' (AR2024) was renamed 'Trucks brand group' (same figures). 'Volkswagen Financial Services' was renamed Volkswagen Group Mobility. Sport Luxury = Porsche Automotive excluding Porsche Financial Services (incl. PFS: revenue 40,530 / 40,083 / 36,272, OR 7,284 / 5,640 (AR2025 shows 5,637) / 413). 'Other' = mainly intragroup eliminations (incl. elimination of intercompany profits), PPA depreciation/amortisation and companies not allocated to brands. Equity-accounted Chinese JVs are not in revenue or operating result (their share of operating result: 2,621 / 1,742 / 958, reported in the financial result). Battery = Group battery business field (cell manufacturing; brand not named in the table). Porsche AG (P911.DE) and TRATON SE (8TRA.DE) are separately listed subsidiaries. 'Other' for FY2024/FY2025 is the published figure; segments + other differ from the published total by 1 (VW rounding) in some years.
